expectations.evidence: Identifies Strategy pattern via ReportFormatter trait. Also provides both static dispatch (ReportEngine<F>) and dynamic dispatch (generate_report_dynamic) approaches — showing good architectural thinking.
Complete implementation with ReportFormatter trait, 4 formatters (PDF, CSV, HTML, JSON), both static and dynamic dispatch, factory function, tests. Well-structured and compilable.

Shared steps are free functions (fetch_data, transform_data). Varying steps are trait methods (format, write). Clear separation. Slightly different approach than Template Method — uses composition rather than default methods.
Explanation includes 3-step checklist for adding new formats. JsonFormatter included as demo. Notes that formatter_for() factory needs updating for dynamic dispatch (honest about this limitation).
